node.title: Re: Use 'use' in foreach
node.author: hippo
node.doctext:
which is not working

Blue smoke? It is likely "not working" because [doc://use] is a compile-time action. With [metamod://Module::Load] it is trivial.

#!/usr/bin/env perl use strict; use warnings; use Module::Load; my @mods = ('JSON', 'CGI::Lite'); for my $mod (@mods) { load $mod; print "$mod version is " . $mod->VERSION . "\n"; }

This can also be done with [doc://require] if you don't fancy using the module.
